value.rationale: Complete sharp infinite-prime classification of the canonical coefficient-one three-point nonabelian convolution problem for complement order three. The natural all-quotient-coset support condition forces exactly two null directions generically, but produces a 2p-dimensional kernel precisely on subgroup cosets. It supplies all geometric extremizers and closed multiplicities relevant to Fourier uncertainty and operator invertibility, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
